filters
| essql 
  query="SELECT timestamp AS \"Time\", batchid AS \"Log batch\", CONCAT(firstname, CONCAT(' ', lastname)) AS Lumberjack, loglength AS \"Log length\", logdiameter AS \"Log diameter\", numberoflogs AS \"Number of logs\", volume AS \"Cubic meters\"  
FROM \"logs-unified*\"
WHERE timestamp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY timestamp DESC"
| table 
  font={font family="'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" size=14 align="left" color="#000000" weight="normal" underline=false italic=false} showHeader=true paginate=true perPage=10
| render

| essql 
  query="SELECT CONCAT(firstname, CONCAT(' ', lastname)) AS Lumberjack, volume AS \"Cubic meters\"
FROM \"logs-unified*\"
WHERE volume != 0 AND volume IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY \"Cubic meters\" DESC
LIMIT 10"
| pointseries x="Cubic meters" y="Lumberjack" color="project"
| plot defaultStyle={seriesStyle bars=0.75 horizontalBars=true} legend=false
| render
